## Analyzers (1)

### RDAP `v1.0`
Look up domain and IP registration data over RDAP, the IETF successor to WHOIS. No API key required.

- **Author:** yatuk
- **License:** AGPL-V3
- **Data Types:** `domain`, `ip`
- **Configuration:** [View config](https://github.com/TheHive-Project/Cortex-Analyzers/blob/master/analyzers/RDAP/RDAP.json)
